newsitem.title: GERMANY: First German peacekeeper killed on Bosnian mission.
newsitem.headline: First German peacekeeper killed on Bosnian mission.

text.p: A German border guard taking part in an international police task force (IPTF) in former Yugoslavia was killed in a traffic accident in suburban Sarajevo on Friday night, a German Interior Ministry spokesman said on Saturday.
It was the first German fatality in former Yugoslavia, where Germany has 150 police officers and about 3,300 soldiers taking part in the international peacekeeping mission.

The 35-year-old border guard was killed on duty when the mini-bus in which he was riding in crashed mid-evening in the Bosnian capital's suburb of Vogosca. Another German in the vehicle, a police officer from the state of North Rhine-Westphalia, was injured.

"The exact cause of the accident is still under investigation," said interior ministry spokesman Roger Kiel. "There are no indications that anyone else was involved. It appears to be a traffic accident."
